XMLDB.COMMENT: MCP web service plugin database schema.

TABLE.NAME: webservice_elediamcp_token
TABLE.COMMENT: Lifecycle and audit metadata for MCP web service tokens. Authentication is delegated to the core external_tokens row referenced by externaltokenid; this table tracks the MCP-specific scope, label, expiry and revocation state, and survives deletion of the core token so a revoked token stays auditable.

FIELD.NAME: externaltokenid
FIELD.COMMENT: Reference to the backing external_tokens.id while the token is live; nulled when the core token is deleted on revocation.

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hex digest of the token value, used to correlate without persisting the secret.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the token (the Moodle user the token authenticates as).

FIELD.NAME: externalserviceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The MCP external service the token is scoped to.

FIELD.NAME: creatorid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the token (the authenticated user for UI-created tokens, or the user on whose behalf a first-party plugin acted).

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Frankenstyle component of the first-party plugin that provisioned the token via the internal API, or null for self-service tokens.

FIELD.NAME: validuntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Expiry timestamp mirrored from the core token, retained for display after revocation. 0 or null means no expiry.

FIELD.NAME: lastaccess
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the last-used timestamp, taken at revocation so it survives deletion of the core token.

FIELD.NAME: revoked
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the token has been revoked, 0 otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: revokedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who revoked the token, or null when revoked programmatically.

INDEX.NAME: tokenhash
INDEX.COMMENT: Used to correlate a presented token value with its metadata row.

INDEX.NAME: userid-revoked
INDEX.COMMENT: Used to list a user's active or revoked tokens.
